description.value:
Sweep your gunblade through a 5-foot emanation. Each enemy in the area attempts a basic Reflex save against your Gunbreaker class DC. Roll the damage once: 1d4 slashing damage per 2 levels, rounded up. This is not a Strike; do not add weapon damage, runes, Strength, or specialization. This activity does not use or increase multiple attack penalty.

After resolving the saves, begin the area combo, enabling Demon Slaughter until the end of your next turn. At least one enemy must be in the area.

@Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d4[slashing]] — @Check[type:reflex|against:gunbreaker|basic:true]
